global: This shoyu ramen features a rich, amber broth with a heart-shaped nori, a soft-boiled egg, and tender chashu pork. Served in a white bowl with “大勝軒” marked, it rests on a dark tray under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden tray with textured woven mat, smooth surface, rectangular shape, visible grain patterns.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, featuring black Japanese characters and a smooth, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green garnish.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a firm white and runny orange yolk with a slightly textured surface.
regions.seaweed: Heart-shaped nori seaweed, dark green with textured surface, appears slightly curled and glistening with broth.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice: golden-brown, tender-looking, curved, with glistening surface and faint marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly curled, fibrous strips with a textured, cooked surface.
